title: team-process session record
description: Durable run ledger for one team-process session. Each concurrent run is its own file at .team-process/run/sessions/<id>.json (id = sanitized team name). The EXISTENCE of any such file = team mode active. Written initial-minimal by the team-mode hook on TeamCreate; enriched by the orchestrator as the run proceeds (roster, phase, ledger). Read on SessionStart to resume + remind. 'workflow' classifies how to resume (feature-team vs freeform). Most fields optional so the minimal hook-written record validates.

id.description: Session id = the record's filename stem; sanitized team name ([A-Za-z0-9._-]).

workflow.description: Which workflow produced this session — drives how resume continues.

team.description: TeamCreate name (also the team_name members must set).

task.description: Freeform: the scheduled-task description. Omitted for feature-team (its spec is the issue).

phase.description: Resume cursor. feature-team uses the process.md phase enum; freeform uses any non-empty string.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last ledger update.

roster.description: Spawned members and their lanes. Source of truth for run/lane (projected via -SyncLane).

ledger.description: One entry per wave: what changed / was decided / was deferred.

allOf.description: feature-team sessions follow the process.md phase vocabulary; freeform sessions may use any non-empty phase string.
